title: Grade 4 SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — General Assessment #15

pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these helps to keep teeth healthy? (1 mark)
   A. Brushing twice a day
   B. Biting hard objects
   C. Eating many sweets
   D. Never visiting a dentist

2. Why should you wear shoes and wash hands to prevent worms? (1 mark)
   A. Water makes worms grow
   B. Worm eggs are found in dirty soil and on dirty hands
   C. Shoes make food digest
   D. Worms live in shoes

3. A pump pushing air into a tyre is an example of (1 mark)
   A. A colour
   B. A gas
   C. A force
   D. A shadow

4. A jug has 400 ml of water. Fatuma adds 250 ml. How much water is in the jug? (1 mark)
   A. 650 ml
   B. 150 ml
   C. 450 ml
   D. 600 ml

5. A cup can hold about (1 mark)
   A. 2500 ml
   B. 250 ml
   C. 25 ml
   D. 25 litres

6. Which of these artificial sources charges its battery in the sun? (1 mark)
   A. Lightning
   B. Sun
   C. Solar lamp
   D. Stars

7. Which of these is a danger of solid waste? (1 mark)
   A. It makes air fresh
   B. It blocks drains and causes floods
   C. It grows food
   D. It cleans rivers

8. Which of these only reflects light? (1 mark)
   A. The moon
   B. A torch
   C. A firefly
   D. A candle

9. Which of these gases do we breathe in to stay alive? (1 mark)
   A. Smoke
   B. Dust
   C. Petrol fumes
   D. Oxygen

10. What is a transparent material? (1 mark)
   A. A material that lets almost all light pass through
   B. A material that blocks all light
   C. A material that makes light
   D. A material that is always red

11. Maize lives for one season and then dies. A baobab lives for many years. What does this show? (1 mark)
   A. Baobab does not die
   B. Plants live for different lengths of time
   C. Maize never grows
   D. Only maize is alive

12. Which force slows down or stops a book sliding on the floor? (1 mark)
   A. Friction
   B. Light
   C. Gravity
   D. Heat

13. What comes out of a bean seed first when it starts to grow? (1 mark)
   A. A fruit
   B. A new seed
   C. A flower
   D. A root

14. Which of these is a pull? (1 mark)
   A. Opening a drawer by its handle
   B. Closing a door by pushing
   C. Pressing a bell
   D. Kicking a ball

15. Which use of heat makes cloth smooth? (1 mark)
   A. Playing music
   B. Ironing clothes
   C. Making shadows
   D. Reading a book

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give four healthy eating habits that keep the digestive system healthy. (4 marks)

17. Explain the importance of heat in daily life. (5 marks)

18. Describe the journey of a mouthful of food from the mouth to the anus. (4 marks)

19. Why should you wear gloves when collecting waste? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Brushing twice a day
   Brushing removes food remains and prevents tooth decay.

2. B — Worm eggs are found in dirty soil and on dirty hands
   Worm eggs can enter the body through dirt.

3. C — A force
   The pump pushes air by force.

4. A — 650 ml
   400 + 250 = 650 ml.

5. B — 250 ml
   A cup holds about 250 ml.

6. C — Solar lamp
   A solar lamp is made by people.

7. B — It blocks drains and causes floods
   Waste blocks drains and water floods the area.

8. A — The moon
   The moon reflects sunlight.

9. D — Oxygen
   Oxygen in the air is needed for life.

10. A — A material that lets almost all light pass through
   Transparent materials let us see clearly through them.

11. B — Plants live for different lengths of time
   All plants die, but some live for one season and others for many years.

12. A — Friction
   Friction opposes the movement between surfaces.

13. D — A root
   The root comes out first and grows down into the soil.

14. A — Opening a drawer by its handle
   A handle is pulled toward you.

15. B — Ironing clothes
   A hot iron flattens cloth.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Eat a balanced diet, eat fruits and vegetables, drink clean water, chew slowly, wash fruits, avoid rotten food, cover food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit up to 4.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Heat keeps us warm, cooks food, dries clothes and crops, helps plants grow, makes rain by evaporation, and is used to make metals and glass.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point up to 5.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Chewed in the mouth, swallowed, pushed down the gullet, churned in the stomach, digested and absorbed in the small intestine, water taken back in the large intestine, faeces stored in the rectum and passed out of the anus.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for every two correct steps up to 4.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: To protect your hands from cuts and germs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for cuts and 1 mark for germs.
